services.name: Dolphin Tours
services.desc: The Sunny Lady runs Dolphin Cruises daily. Family owned and operated, this is an ideal way to enjoy a relaxing 1.5 hour cruise watching dolphins play in their natural habitat. These boats feature a snack bar, restrooms and an air conditioned/heated cabin. The Dolphin Cruises are 1.5 hour cruises through the Scenic Back Bays of Orange Beach. See Dolphins in their natural habitat while noticing the beauty of the Gulf Coast shoreline. Enjoy an afternoon or sunset cruise depending on the season. Concession stand on board for light snacks and beverages. The Sunny Lady is perfectly equipped for your event.
